name: proofrank
description: Evidence-first site graph audits that withhold unsupported conclusions.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence before action. No guessing from partial crawls.
interface.longDescription: Audit multilingual site graphs from saved inventories, sitemaps, and HTML caches. ProofRank separates confirmed evidence, cautious candidates, and withheld conclusions—and stops whole-site claims when coverage is incomplete.
defaultPrompt: Audit this site's saved graph without changing anything.
Find orphan and internal-link candidates from this cache.
Explain what is confirmed, candidate, or withheld by the current coverage.
